{{Quote|Everybody uses pseudos in places like that. The guy's was ''Rancor's Wrath''. It's just a bar.|Javul Charn|<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>}}
'''Rancor's Wrath''' was a pseudonym that was adopted by a tall, slender, [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who visited the [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] [[Every Delight]] in [[Port Town (Rodia)|Port Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. The individual wore large amounts of make-up in order to conceal his identity and while in the bar, he acquainted himself with the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]], who was similarly disguised and whom he knew only by the moniker "Night Cat." After Charn's security guards [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and [[Eaden Vrill]] came to the bar in search of her, the individual confronted them and asked "Night Cat" whether the pair were bothering her.
